info.text:
Americans' confidence just jumped 11.4 points in one month.
The Conference Board index hit 103.3 in November, the highest since January 2025.
The expectations index rose to 83.6, its first reading this year above 80, the level the Conference Board says usually signals a recession ahead.
But people still expect prices to rise 5.7% over the next year.
Sources: The Conference Board (Nov 24, 2026), CNBC.
News and education, not financial advice.
